verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke has a documented Patents group page under its IP practice, but the evidence describes contentious work: UK Supreme Court and UPC litigation, FRAND/SEP disputes such as Optis v Apple, and pan-European litigation strategy. Nothing shows it drafts or files patent applications or builds portfolios; the only filing programmes mentioned cover trade marks and designs. Missing for 10: evidence of patent drafting, filing and prosecution services, portfolio-building or defensive patent strategy, and named patent practitioners.
